name: 23505 · Norfolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23505 (Norfolk) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23505 (Norfolk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
